entries.4cc24cb4c788b859: Based on its group management master plan, 'Toward 2030: Evolution and Challenge,' it has formulated a medium-term management plan. Its priority issues are 'Succession and sharing of corporate philosophy,' 'Developing and discovering people suited to the times,' 'Evolution of group businesses,' and 'Strengthening of management foundations.' For the fiscal year ending March 2027, it plans to focus in the Car Accessories Business on improving customer service and technical quality, with emphasis on the pit service division and used car purchasing and sales; in the Bridal Business, to advance personnel development and digitalization; and in the Construction and Real Estate Business, to work on expanding real estate sales in line with market conditions and expanding its business areas in solar power generation equipment and electric vehicle charging systems.
